leads.description:
Claude Duet is available through a waitlist. Before you download, check that you've received our email saying your account has access. If you haven't, join the waitlist at claude.com/product/claude-duet.

WAKE UP KNOWING WHAT NEEDS YOUR ATTENTION
Each morning, Claude Duet looks across your email and calendar and brings you the few things that need a decision or a reply. It provides context on each one, so you have what you need to decide right there. Where it can, it has a draft ready for you to review. Through the day, it checks your connected accounts every few hours and flags what's gone quiet, like a client email you haven't answered in a few days.

HAND IT OFF
Ask in a chat or add a task. Claude Duet gets going, sends you updates as it works, and tells you when it needs your review.

GET THINGS MADE FROM A SINGLE MESSAGE
Describe what you need in one message. It comes back as work you can check, like a brief, research, or a draft.

YOU HAVE THE FINAL SAY
Claude Duet waits for your okay before it sends, posts, pays, or deletes anything. It works with the apps you've connected to Claude, and you can disconnect any of them at any time.

ORGANIZE BY CHANNEL
Keep each part of your work in its own channel, like one for finance and one for hiring. Claude Duet can read across all of them, so it keeps the whole picture.

THE CLAUDE YOU KNOW
Claude Duet runs on your Claude account, with your memory, skills, and connected apps like Gmail and Google Calendar there from the first message.

IT KEEPS WORKING
Claude Duet works in the background even after you close the app. It will let you know when it's done or needs your approval.

TALK IT THROUGH
When you'd rather talk than type, hold to talk or have a spoken conversation.

WHAT TO EXPECT
We built Claude Duet for work, so it's weaker at personal errands. It can make mistakes, including about what's urgent. Emails and web pages written by other people can contain hidden instructions meant to mislead it. Claude Duet is built to resist these, but review what it shows you before you approve. Because it checks every few hours, something urgent can arrive between checks. Learn more at support.claude.com/en/articles/17631495.

HOW TO GET ACCESS
Join the waitlist at claude.com/product/claude-duet. We'll be adding people gradually, and we'll email you when your account has access. Please note, signing into the app doesn't add you to the waitlist.

leads.description:
Cash Advance - Speedy Cash — your reliable helper when life throws unexpected financial challenges your way.
When sudden expenses arise, there’s no need to blame yourself for poor planning or lack of financial knowledge. Sometimes you just need a quick and convenient solution for a temporary shortfall. That’s exactly what Cash Advance - Speedy Cash delivers.
Whether it’s an urgent car repair, a major home emergency, medical bills, or any other unforeseen situation, our app steps in immediately. No more stressful searches for cash or long waits. Submit your application any time — day or night, even on weekends and holidays — and receive the funds almost instantly. Fast, simple, and stress-free.
Here for Whatever Life Brings
Our users turn to Cash Advance - Speedy Cash both for sudden financial emergencies and for planned larger purchases. The most frequent reasons include:
•  Covering everyday bills when payday is still a few days away
•  Making a big purchase without completely emptying family savings
•  Avoiding lengthy bank approval processes
•  Not wanting to ask friends or relatives for money
These situations can happen to anyone. Cash Advance - Speedy Cash offers a convenient, modern solution that saves your time and nerves.
Simple and Fully Transparent
We believe borrowing should be clear and understandable for everyone. That’s why Cash Advance - Speedy Cash was built with maximum simplicity in mind. No confusing financial terms, no hidden fees, and no complicated calculations.
All the important information is displayed clearly and upfront. You see the exact terms and make an informed decision.
Important Information
Submitting an application does not obligate you to accept the loan. You review the personalized offer first and only proceed if the conditions suit you. Before any agreement, you will clearly see:
•  Repayment term: from 65 days to 24 months
•  Interest rate: from 5.99% to 35.99% (individual rate based on your profile)
•  APR: the full cost of the loan shown transparently
You are always in control — take the offer or decline it without any consequences.
Representative Example
Imagine your laptop, which you need for work, suddenly fails. You don’t have the $850 to replace it right away, so you apply for a loan with a 6-month repayment period.
Cash Advance - Speedy Cash offers you the funds instantly at a 14% interest rate. Your monthly payment will be $152.80. The total amount to repay will be $916.80, which includes the $850 borrowed plus $66.80 in interest.
This way, you can easily plan your budget and avoid unpleasant surprises.
Getting Started Is Extremely Easy
The application process takes just a few minutes:
•  Fill out a short and simple form
•  No income verification paperwork required
•  Everything is done online — no need to visit any office
•  Fast decision and instant funding when approved
Your personal and financial data is protected with advanced encryption technology. Cash Advance - Speedy Cash provides a safe, discreet, and reliable way to solve your financial needs.

leads.description:
The Floor is a nonpartisan civic engagement app for following real U.S. House and Senate legislation.
Browse tracked bills, read plain-language summaries, cast your own Yes or No vote, and compare your position with the broader Floor community. After onboarding, The Floor matches you to your congressional district and senators so you can see how your delegation votes on the bills you care about.
The Floor helps you:
Browse active House and Senate bills
Vote Yes or No before Congress does
See community vote splits and discussion
Compare your record with your representative, senators, parties, and other users
Play Daily Floor, a quick civic quiz built around real votes
Follow leaderboard rankings by constituent and national alignment
Manage floor alerts, vote updates, Daily Floor reminders, and weekly digests
The Floor is not affiliated with Congress, the U.S. government, or any government agency. Legislative information is sourced from official and public government records, including Congress.gov, and is presented for civic education, voting comparison, and discussion.

Three Core Highlights Designed Just for You:
Daily Verses & Devotional Guidance
Every morning, we carefully select KJV verses and short devotionals tailored to your daily mood, helping you stay rooted in God's Word—from your morning prayers to your daily reading routine. Whether you seek comfort, wisdom, or strength, you will find the specific spiritual nourishment you need right here, allowing your faith to become an integral part of your everyday life.

leads.description:
Read the clues. Draw the suspect. Solve the case.

Find the Suspect is a drawing game and a detective story. Play 20 free drawing games, or open Inner Circle and search a dead singer's phone for the truth.

INNER CIRCLE
Hattie Vale drowned in a friend's pool. The police say she was high and fell. Her sister Helen does not believe it, and she has Hattie's phone. Helen asks you one question at a time. Look through chats, photos, notes, voicemails, recordings, bank records, mail and more, then type your answer. Helen replies to every guess. Answer all 19 questions, then name the killer.

The phone and its apps are made up for the game. They never read your own messages, photos, contacts or files. The whole case is on your device and plays offline.

DRAW THE SUSPECT
Read three witness statements. Combine the clues and draw the suspect in your own style. Send your sketch to the AI judge for a verdict and a match score. A network connection and your permission are required before a sketch is sent.

- One long fictional case with 19 questions and an ending
- A made-up phone with 22 apps to search
- Type your answers in your own words
- 20 free drawing games with an AI judge
- Saved progress, no account, no ads

PREMIUM
Stuck? Premium gives you hints in the case: a hint, a deeper hint, then the answer, each with a link to the app that holds the clue. You can finish the case without hints. Inner Circle and all 20 drawing games are free.

Choose a weekly or yearly auto-renewable subscription. The app shows the local store price and billing period before purchase. Payment is charged to your App Store account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled. Manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings. Restore purchases in Settings.

All characters and events are invented.

Privacy Policy: https://findthesuspect.web.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Find the Suspect is a drawing game and a detective story. Play 20 free drawing games, or open Inner Circle and search a dead singer's phone for the truth.

INNER CIRCLE
Hattie Vale drowned in a friend's pool. The police say she was high and fell. Her sister Helen does not believe it, and she has Hattie's phone. Helen asks you one question at a time. Look through chats, photos, notes, voicemails, recordings, bank records, mail and more, then type your answer. Helen replies to every guess. Answer all 19 questions, then name the killer.

The phone and its apps are made up for the game. They never read your own messages, photos, contacts or files. The whole case is on your device and plays offline.

DRAW THE SUSPECT
Read three witness statements. Combine the clues and draw the suspect in your own style. Send your sketch to the AI judge for a verdict and a match score. A network connection and your permission are required before a sketch is sent.

- One long fictional case with 19 questions and an ending
- A made-up phone with 22 apps to search
- Type your answers in your own words
- 20 free drawing games with an AI judge
- Saved progress, no account, no ads

PREMIUM
Stuck? Premium gives you hints in the case: a hint, a deeper hint, then the answer, each with a link to the app that holds the clue. You can finish the case without hints. Inner Circle and all 20 drawing games are free.

Choose a weekly or yearly auto-renewable subscription. The app shows the local store price and billing period before purchase. Payment is charged to your App Store account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled. Manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings. Restore purchases in Settings.

All characters and events are invented.

Privacy Policy: https://findthesuspect.web.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

leads.description:
zeha is an AI roleplay chat app built around characters and interactive stories — for people who want more than a simple AI chatbot. Talk with memorable AI characters, build relationships that last, and step into stories that remember what happened before.

Choose a character, start a conversation, and let the scene evolve. Your AI companion, friend, girlfriend, boyfriend, rival, crush, mentor, or fantasy hero keeps a stable personality, stays in character, and continues the same world over time. If the story takes a wrong turn, edit the dialogue, adjust the plot, and guide the next chapter your way.

EXPLORE RICH AI CHARACTERS
- AI girlfriend and AI boyfriend arcs — gentle, dramatic, or slow-burn romance
- Anime-inspired friends, rivals, and waifu characters
- Fantasy heroes, villains, mages, vampires, and supernatural beings
- Mystery partners for suspense, secrets, and clue-driven scenes
- School life, slice-of-life, comedy, and everyday chat roles
- Sci-fi pilots, androids, space travelers, and future worlds
- Historical figures, legends, and mythic companions
- Cozy friends for daily check-ins and casual talk
- Adventure characters for quests, battles, and roleplay game worlds
- Custom personas for private RP, writing practice, and creative play

CHAT WITH MEMORY AND PERSONALITY
zeha is designed for deeper AI character chat. Characters remember important details, keep their own tone, and respond as part of an ongoing relationship. Build a long-term AI friend, a romantic AI girlfriend or AI boyfriend story, a fictional companion, or a cast that grows with your choices.

CONTROL THE STORY DIRECTION
Interactive fiction should not trap you in one path. In zeha, you can change a reply, rewrite your own message, and steer the plot whenever the story needs a better twist. Turn a casual talk into a romance, a fantasy quest, a mystery case, a reunion, or a quiet scene between friends.

GENERATE IMAGES FROM YOUR CHAT
Bring key moments to life with images that fit the character and scene. Capture a confession, a fantasy setting, a dramatic reveal, an anime-style portrait, or a visual memory from your story.

CREATE YOUR OWN AI CHARACTERS AND PLOTS
Do not just browse characters. Build your own. Create a unique AI persona, define their personality, write a backstory, set relationship dynamics, and shape the plot you want to explore. Keep the character private or share the world with friends.

MADE FOR MANY CREATIVE MOODS
Use zeha when you want to:
- Talk with an AI friend who remembers your shared history
- Explore an AI girlfriend or AI boyfriend story at your own pace
- Roleplay with anime, fantasy, or original characters
- Create plot ideas for interactive fiction and chat stories
- Generate scene images from important story moments
- Build a private character world and share it with friends
- Practice dialogue, character writing, and creative storytelling

FAQ

Can I create my own AI character?
Yes. Design an original character, define their personality, choose the relationship, and build a custom plot around them.

Can I change the story after a chat starts?
Yes. Edit the dialogue and guide the story direction — fix a scene, try another path, or turn the plot toward a new idea.

Can zeha generate images?
Yes. Create images based on your AI character, conversation, and scene, and make your story world easier to imagine and share.

Is zeha only for romance?
No. An AI girlfriend or AI boyfriend story is one direction, but zeha also supports friendship, fantasy, mystery, comedy, adventure, anime roleplay, RP with original characters, character creation, and creative writing.

Start your zeha story today. Talk with AI characters, roleplay your favorite worlds, create your own persona, build interactive fiction, generate scene images, and shape a story that keeps growing with every message.

Privacy Policy: http://www.zeha-ai.io/privacy.html
Terms of Use: http://www.zeha-ai.io/terms.html
